item.text: I’ll inspect the local API documentation first, then compute the reconciliation with a retrying, rate-limit-aware script and leave only `result.json` as the deliverable.

item.aggregated_output:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

item.text: The full listing has been processed with retries and de-duplication; I’m now writing and validating the requested result file.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'keys == [\"by_region\",\"duplicates_skipped\",\"order_count\",\"total_cents\"] and (.by_region | keys == [\"east\",\"north\",\"south\",\"west\"]) and (.by_region | add) == .total_cents' result.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'keys == [\"by_region\",\"duplicates_skipped\",\"order_count\",\"total_cents\"] and (.by_region | keys == [\"east\",\"north\",\"south\",\"west\"]) and (.by_region | add) == .total_cents' result.json && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('result.json','utf8')); const top=Object.keys(x).sort().join(',')==='by_region,duplicates_skipped,order_count,total_cents'; const regs=Object.keys(x.by_region).sort().join(',')==='east,north,south,west'; const sum=Object.values(x.by_region).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)===x.total_cents; if("'!top||!regs||!sum) process.exit(1); console.log('"'result.json validated')\""
